report.checker: conformance.py reference checker, run by the operator; this service signed the operator-submitted result

VLC-L1-1.note: chain consistent AND its head equal the value(s) supplied independently of the log

VLC-L1-3.note: end marker is bound by the chain and names the recomputed head

VLC-L2-1.note: adapter declares no production count or ordinal

VLC-L3-6.note: observation surface is not enumerable and is not declared as such

VLC-L3i-1.note: adapter declares no interval attestation; L3i is not claimed by this producer

VLC-L5-1.note: producer declared 'self_reported': the audited process writes its own record, so the record is a claim

VLC-L5-2.note: The ledger is operated by the same company whose specifications, datasets and gate measurements appear in it, and the op

VLC-L5-3.note: no reconciliation against a self-reported record declared

VLC-L5-4.note: the witnessing log itself is only L1: a witness with an undeclared coverage gap agrees with a lie honestly

VLC-L5-6.note: the witness gives no basis for its coverage being exhaustive: it can corroborate what it observed, not that it observed everything

expected_head.source_note: entry_sha256 of the jidec-head-v1 marker from GET /ledger/head at capture time; the same value the stamped nenrin checkpoint entries carry

signature.signed: canonical JSON of .report (sorted keys, compact separators)

verify_with: tools/verify_report.py in the spec repo, against keys/vlc-report-signing.pub.json
